description: This file defines functions for generating and rendering a documentation navigation structure by reading data from a CMS or database via the reader object. It includes data processing to map navigation items to URLs and exposes a React component for navigation rendering.

methods.name: getNavigationMap
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves navigation data from the reader, maps pages by slug, and constructs a navigation map suitable for rendering.

methods.name: DocsNavigation
methods.description: React component that fetches the navigation map and renders the DocsNavigationClient component with it.
